title: Toast with butter & jam
summary: Two minutes, one toaster: a quick, safe demo.
source: Written for REMY by Claude as a simple demo. Waiting for Matthew's review.
notes: Never put a knife or fork into a toaster to get stuck bread out: unplug it first.

steps.instruction: Put the bread in the toaster and push the lever down. Set it to medium.
looks_right: bread down in the toaster slots
looks_wrong: bread too thick to fit (it can jam and burn)

steps.instruction: When it pops up, take the toast out and put it on the plate.
looks_wrong: black, burnt edges (scrape or start again)
still pale (put it back down for a bit)
using a knife to fish out stuck bread (unplug the toaster first)
steps.done_when: Golden toast is on the plate.

steps.instruction: Spread the butter while it's hot, then add the jam all the way to the edges.
looks_right: jam spread right to the crust
looks_wrong: butter in cold lumps (the toast went cold first)
a blob of jam in the middle only
steps.done_when: Buttered, jammed and ready to eat.
